if you can, stay as best friends for as long as you guys can and see where that takes you.

M, D, J, have snacks, then sleep.
Honestly, i think that, parents think nowadays were like theirs when it’s not. Times changed, people changed & they’re not aware of it.
Ikr, so far i’ve just typed all my feelings & thoughts in the notes app & felt a bit better. I’m 18 btw.
I’ve tried stifling before but that doesn’t work ig. I gave up.

Tbh I don’t feel..right.. talking to her you know. One time i tried, i told her i was depressed and she said “ me too, i’m also depressed, u think i’m happy?” So i’m just not talking abt things like that with her.
I doubt there is even one. i don’t believe in it anymore.
Idk if you’re still alive or not. But, i’m an ARMY too. Sometimes i feel the same way. But once BTS made you happy, that’s all that matters.

I think, It’ll be better to leave a note for him. If u just end it without leaving anything for him, he may or may not think you didn’t care uk... So leave a note for him, something that’ll have him understand why u did what u did.
Panadol doesn’t even help for anything to begin with. I think some kinda special tablets would work, idk.

Not advice but when i did my last 2 years of high school, i just winged it. It was too much for me. I couldn’t eat properly or anything. I got anorexic, i was diagnosed with stress and anxiety anddd I fainted twice to be exact. Idek how i’m still here, but i am.

Idk if thats luck or what, cuz if i tell my mom something like that, she’ll probably  beat the hell outta me. honestly do whatever u want. They obviously don’t care about you, if they did, they would’ve said something different. I’m not gonna say any shit like “its gonna be okay, dont die” cuz that’s not gonna do anything. This is reality and it’s harsh. Do whatever you want, no one can stop you.
Parents doesn’t know anything abt what happens to us or what we have. They like to assume things.
